props.name: available
props.description: Whether a new version is waiting. Set it when the service worker or version check reports one.

props.name: onReload
props.description: Reloads onto the new version — usually `registration.waiting.postMessage` then `location.reload()`.

props.name: version
props.description: The waiting version, shown after the title. A new version string brings a dismissed prompt back.

props.name: description
props.defaultValue: 'Reload to get the latest fixes. Anything you have not saved on this page will be lost.'
props.description: One line on why reloading is worth it.

props.name: whatsNewLabel
props.description: Label on the release notes link.

props.name: onLater
props.description: Called when the reader chooses to finish what they are doing first.

props.name: snoozeMinutes
props.description: Minutes a snooze hides the prompt for. Pass 0 to leave the snooze out.

props.name: onSnooze
props.description: Called with the moment the snoozed prompt will return.

props.name: reloading
props.description: Shows the reload as in progress — the new worker is activating.

props.name: variant
props.description: toast floats as a card; banner is a full-width strip.

props.name: fixed
props.description: Pin to the viewport — bottom corner for a toast, top edge for a banner — instead of sitting in the flow.
